 Round Rock Offers Free Rides on Election Day
 October 29, 2026 
 12:39 pm 
 Round Rock residents can ride for free on Tuesday, Nov. 3, as part of CapMetro’s “Fare-Free ” to Vote initiative . 
 Free rides will be available on all Round Rock Routes throughout Election Day.  Round Rock Rides will also participate in the promotion, provided riders follow the standard reservation procedures and availability .
 Free fares are available on Election Day only, no refunds on reservations booked prior to promotion.
 For more information on the election and voting locations, visit Williamson County Polling Locations  or Travis County Polling Locations .
